title: Validate adaptive light and dark icons in distribution exports
outcome: The distribution export gate verifies the declared light/dark iPhone icons and default Watch icon and rejects malformed or missing renditions.

included: Update the stale single-icon distribution check for adaptive icon catalogs.
Add focused negative cases for missing/duplicate/unexpected appearances and invalid icon metadata.
excluded: Product source, version/build, signing/export/upload, devices, simulator state and external tracker changes.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Valid default/dark iPhone and default Watch renditions pass; missing, duplicate or invalid renditions fail.
Export report preserves a default rendition digest and records each validated appearance independently.
